A little clarity.
An easier visit.

How do I enquire about an appointment?

Call +91 8757731665 to confirm doctor availability and appointment timings. A website click does not confirm a booking.

What is the consultation fee?

Consultation starts at ₹500. The fee may vary by doctor or service; confirm the applicable fee with the hospital.

Where is the hospital located?

The hospital is at Ratu Road Chowk, Ranchi, Jharkhand. Use the Google listing link for directions.

How can I confirm diagnostic tests and charges?

Call the hospital before your visit to confirm the test, timing, preparation and charges.

How do I contact emergency care?

24×7 emergency care is advertised by the hospital. Call +91 8757731665 directly for assistance.
